title: aitmpl.com catalog API v1
description: The catalog of Claude Code components published at https://www.aitmpl.com/api/v1/catalog.json and /api/v1/catalog/{type}.json. The root schema describes those documents; $defs/version describes /api/v1/version.json. Within schemaVersion 1.x changes are additive only: consumers must ignore fields and type values they do not know.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this format. The major is always 1 at /api/v1/.

type.description: Component type, plural. New values may be added in a minor version.

generatedAt.description: When the components last changed (content or download counts).

source.description: Repository the catalog is generated from.

components.description: Sorted by id, ascending. The order never depends on downloads, sponsorship or anything else.

component.description: Every field listed here is always present; optional values are null, never missing or an empty string.

id.description: {type}/{category}/{name}. Unique in the catalog and permanent for the component; a moved or renamed component gets a new id.

name.description: Last segment of path, without extension. Not unique on its own.

path.description: Location under cli-tool/components/{type}/ in the repository: {category}/{name}.md, {category}/{name}.json, or {category}/{name} for skills and mods (directories).

description.description: Verbatim from the component's frontmatter or JSON; may be empty and may contain Markdown or <example> blocks.

repo.description: Upstream repository, when the component declares one.

downloads.description: Total recorded installs through the CLI. Refreshed daily.

command.description: Shell command that installs the component in the current project.

args.description: Arguments to pass after `npx claude-code-templates@latest`, as argv (no shell).

source.description: The component on GitHub. For an external skill (see `source`), its folder in the author's repository at the pinned commit.

content.description: JSON with the installed file as `content` (plus `files` for mods). Not covered by the v1 stability policy yet. null when the component has no content file.

files.description: Skills and mods: the other files of the directory, relative paths, without the main file (SKILL.md for skills, README.md for mods). null for single-file types.

source.description: External skills only: the code lives in another GitHub repository and the CLI downloads it from this exact commit at install time. null for components stored in this repository.

path.description: Folder of the skill inside that repository; empty for the repository root.

commit.description: The reviewed commit. Never a branch or tag.

license.description: SPDX id of the license at that commit.

scan.description: Latest static security scan. A risk hint for display, not a verdict; never used for ordering. null when the component has not been scanned.

tool.description: Scanner name; currently always skillspector (NVIDIA SkillSpector, static mode).

score.description: Risk score: 0-20 LOW, 21-50 MEDIUM, 51-80 HIGH, 81-100 CRITICAL.

version.description: /api/v1/version.json: poll this (under 1 KB) and download the catalog only when sha256 changes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes of /api/v1/catalog.json.
